assumptions: A code-derived method overview, not a new method or a runtime reproduction.
Solid colors encode operation classes, not trainability: blue=language-model computation, green=retained state, gray-white=tools/runtime, parameter-free checks and I/O.
Feedback arrows indicate later steps or trials, never model gradient updates.
Layout is original; source-paper graphics are not embedded.
The caller must invoke run() again; this class does not automatically retry forever.
A stopped or halted incorrect prior trial triggers reflection before the next trial reset. Correct means normalized exact match, not general semantic correctness.
The reflection list is instance-local context across attempts, not a shared vector database.

Self-reflection takes the question and truncated prior scratchpad; it does not read the entire prior reflection list. Common task conditioning is shown once rather than duplicated as every prompt input.
The actor/tool observation loop is within one attempt; the reflection-memory loop connects later attempts.
